O filtro: quatro papéis e uma armadilha: The filter: four roles and a trap
As 43 oportunidades parecem 43 negócios: The 43 opportunities look like 43 different businesses. Almost all of them fit into a few boxes. Building became easy and cheap, so anyone who only delivers the building competes on price. What a company buys is trust: someone who diagnoses, reviews, follows up and teaches. This lesson builds the filter you will use throughout the whole course.

O funil de confiança e a conversa de 15: The trust funnel and the 15-minute conversation
Ninguém compra na primeira frase. Entre: Nobody buys on the first sentence. Between "this person exists" and "this person is going to get my money" there are small steps, and each one is a separate sale. In the 43 Opportunities the path is the same: proof, lead magnet, conversation, diagnostic and follow-up. The piece that decides everything is the 15-minute conversation.

Você mostra trabalho real em público: um: You show real work in public: a task solved from start to finish, a sample diagnostic, a before and after. This is what makes a stranger recognize you later.
Trabalho pronto e específico para aquele: Finished work, specific to that business, with their name and data visible, delivered with no strings attached. It has to be genuinely good: if the free piece is bad, people assume the paid one is worse. It usually takes two to four hours of your time.
Objetivo único: descobrir se faz sentido: One goal: find out whether it makes sense to work together. Frame it, narrow the pain to one sentence, quantify it, propose the paid next step and end on time.
Diagnóstico identifica o que existe hoje: The diagnostic identifies what exists today and where time and revenue leak. The roadmap solves it: what to do, in what order, at 30, 60, 90 and 180 days. The first opens the door; the second is where the value is.
Treinamento contínuo da equipe, revisão: Ongoing team training, quarterly review with a short report, mentoring. It matters less for its price and more for the reason to keep talking: the next project comes out of conversation.
As três primeiras etapas não faturam nad: The first three steps bill nothing, and they are what make the last two exist.

State the rule of the conversation right at the start. It takes the pressure off both sides.

Proponha o diagnóstico pago com prazo e: Propose the paid diagnostic with the deadline and price said out loud, no beating around the bush. Finishing before the agreed time signals more competence than stretching it to an hour.
